title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Namaltugan, Municipality of Calanasan, Province of Kalinga-apayao, to Be Known as the Calanasan High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Namaltugan, Municipality of Calanasan, Province of Kalinga-apayao, to Be Known as the Calanasan High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Namaltugan, Thị trấn Calanasan, Tỉnh Kalinga-apayao được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Calanasan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Namaltugan, เทศบาล Calanasan, จังหวัด Kalinga-apayao ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calanasan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Namaltugan, Kotamadya Calanasan, Provinsi Kalinga-apayao dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Calanasan

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Namaltugan, Municipality of Calanasan, Province of Kalinga-Apayao, to be known as the Calanasan High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
